source_text: Rachel formosa aspectu; Lia lippis oculis. Duo populi — synagoga et ecclesia; vel vita activa et contemplativa.
pass_a_gloss: Rachel beautiful of-aspect; Leah with-bleared eyes. Two peoples — synagogue and church; or life active and contemplative.
pass_b_english: [[Rachel is beautiful of face; Leah has tender eyes >> Bible:Genesis 29:17]]. Two peoples — synagogue and church; or active and contemplative life.
